<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">抛砖引玉</span></span></b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">(pāo zhuān yǐn yù)</span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Cast Out a Brick to Secure Jade</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
This proverb refers back to Tang Dynasty (618-907 A.D.), when the
poet Chang Jian (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">常建</span></span>,
708-765 A.D.) devised a ploy for achieving collaboration with the
much more renowned Zhao Gu (<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">赵嘏</span></span>,
806-853 A.D.). After learning of a tentative visit by Zhao Gu to the
Divine Rock Temple in Suzhou, it is said that Chang Jian scratched
half of his poem onto the wall of the temple. While passing by, Zhao
Gu was unable to resist the urge to finished Chang Jian’s poem.</span></p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Cast
Out a Brick to Secure Jade</span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
is associated with the fourth hexagram, <i>Thunder
over Water</i>. The
yang line in the fifth position from the top is inexperienced, but is
mistaken as valuable by the arrogant and overreaching, and
subsequently hurled into to the topmost position [1],
[28].</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b>VOCAB LIST 17:</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</p>
<div dir="ltr" id="Section28" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large; text-decoration: none;">this way
	(like so): <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">这样</span></span></span>:
	z</span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">hèyàng   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">that
	way: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那样</span></span>:
	nàyàng   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">massage:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">按摩</span></span>:
	<span style="text-decoration: none;">à</span>nmó</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">to throw/to cast out: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">抛: pāo   
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">to
	joke: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">开玩笑</span></span>:

	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">the

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">brick:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;" lang="zh-CN">砖</span></span>/<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;" lang="zh-CN">砖头: zhuān/zhuāntóu   </span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	</span></p>

	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">finally

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">to

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">baby:

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><a name="tw-source-rmn168"></a><a name="tw-source-rmn167"></a>

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">to

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">to lead/to guide: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;" lang="zh-CN">引导: yǐndǎo   </span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">every

<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b>Sample Sentences 17:</b></span></p>

<div dir="ltr" id="Section69" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	1<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">）她喜欢那样晾衣服。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: That’s how she
	likes to hang clothes.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	2<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">）他为什么经常这样开玩笑？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Why does he always
	joke?</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">3) </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">请把球抛给我。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">4)</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">我们用砖头建造房子。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;">5</span><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">）我后天终于要放假了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;">6</span><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">）我每天</span></span>9<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">点起床。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;">7</span><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">）</span></span>Q:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">你想买多少鸡肉？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">半只鸡。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">8)</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">老师引导我们在玩中学。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span lang="en-US"><span style="text-decoration: none;">9)</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">中国有很多玉吗？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;">10</span><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">）她的宝贝已经可以从一数到十了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;">11</span><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">）我前天去按摩了。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;">12</span><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">）你为什么在床上吃东西？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;">13</span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;">）</span>今天，公园里有很多小鸟。</span></span></p>
